body.name: Partition-aware clique-picking handle
body.construction: Use \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{enum}}\): begin from the ordinary essential graph of \(G\), insert the orientations in \(F(C)\) as background constraints, adapt chordal clique-picking so every orientation is checked against transported parent partitions, and quotient emitted states by symbolic equality of the rational maps \(g_E\).
